note: Which tables hold eMithran reference data (rates, lookups, process and material knowledge: eMithran intellectual property). Built from `npm run migrations:inventory` (step 4 of the on-premises plan). From migration `noNewRowsAfter` on, migrations may change these tables' schema but must not write their rows: reference data ships in versioned, licensed data packages (step 5). `shared` tables hold eMithran rows AND customer rows with no reliable marker of which is which; they need a provenance column before they can be packaged. Checked by src/common/migrations/reference-data.spec.ts.

shared.public.calculators: global calculators have user_id IS NULL; customers' own have a user_id or organization_id
shared.public.costing_settings: eMithran defaults and per-environment overrides in one table
shared.public.mhr_records: global rows are marked three different ways (is_global, user_id IS NULL, organization_id IS NULL), inconsistently
shared.public.raw_materials: user_id is NOT NULL, so seeded rows are owned by whichever account ran the seed

exceptions.978_plastic_material_cut_codes.sql: Writes the cut code of 109 plastic materials onto raw_materials (generated from memory/plastic modeling/materials_final.csv, only where the row has none). The operations that decide from the material's cut code (passivation, magnetic particle testing, carburizing, carbonitriding) stop at 'cut code needed' without it. Remove this entry when raw_materials has a provenance column and the cut codes ship in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.984_restore_secondary_op_catalog_rows_lo: Puts back five process_calculator_mappings rows and their four process_taxonomy rows (counterboring, countersinking, PEM insertion, and tapping on milled and turned parts) that migration 702 restored and migration 731 then deleted by a machine-class keep-list that did not name drill_press, pem_press or tapping. The rows are copied from 731's own backup tables and bind calculators that were never deleted; without them every counterbore, countersink and PEM insert is unresolved and a route holding one cannot be applied. Remove this entry when process_calculator_mappings and process_taxonomy ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.981_black_oxide_wage_grade_labor_rate.sq: Gives each Black Oxide machine row in mhr_records the labor rate of its wage grade ('2 - Metal', memory/SurfaceTreatment/surface_treatment_wage_grades.csv), where the other machines of the grade agree on one value and the row has none; those rows have no labor rate and the engine drops a machine without one. It writes inside a DO block, which the spec's statement scan does not inspect, so it is listed here to be seen. Remove this entry when the rate ships in the reference-data package (step 5).
exceptions.1025_plastic_secondary_op_catalog_rows.s: Adds, under Plastic Molding, the process_taxonomy and process_calculator_mappings rows of the material drying, visual inspection and weight check machine classes (bound by name to the calculators of migrations 1023 and 1024). Without them Apply cannot place those lines (no process group) and refuses the whole route. Remove this entry when process_calculator_mappings and process_taxonomy ship in the reference-data package (step 5) with these rows in it.
exceptions.1026_complete_tapping_table_from_reaming: Adds the tblTapping rows of the 72 material cut codes the source screenshot cut off (aluminum, stainless, copper, titanium, plastics), derived from the staged tblReaming by the rule the 18 present codes follow exactly; without them every thread in those materials is unpriced and its route cannot be applied. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the complete tblTapping in it.
exceptions.1033_simultaneous_turning_route_role.sql: Gives the Simultaneous Turning row of process_taxonomy the route role its sibling lathes have ('primary_turning', migration 780), where it has none; without it the multi-spindle lathes are never offered as a route although their machines are rated and their turning engine is registered. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the role in it.
exceptions.1034_router_route_role.sql: Gives the 3 Axis Router and 5 Axis Router rows of process_taxonomy a route role ('primary_routing', added to the column's allowed values), where they have none; without it the routers are never listed in the route comparison although their machines are rated. Remove this entry when process_taxonomy ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the role in it.
exceptions.1036_milling_removal_rate_table.sql: Stages the milling material removal rates (one per material class, the eMithran baseline) as the lookup table tblMillingRemovalRate in machining_reference_data; they were a table in the cost engine's source, and every milling calculator needs the rate as an input. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the table in it.
exceptions.1039_milling_finishing_table.sql: Stages the finishing end mill cutting speed and feed per material class (the eMithran baseline, from a published carbide end mill chart) as the lookup table tblMillingFinishing in machining_reference_data; the finishing calculators time a tool path at this feed, and memory/Machining has only a partial milling table with no aluminium. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the table in it.
exceptions.1040_machining_min_wall_table.sql: Stages the recommended and feasible minimum wall thickness of a machined part per material class (the eMithran baseline, from published CNC design guides) as the lookup table tblMachiningMinWall in machining_reference_data; the design-for-machining check grades the measured wall against it, and memory/Machining has no wall-thickness limit. Remove this entry when machining_reference_data ships in the reference-data package (step 5) with the table in it.
